Preparing Injectable Alprazolam
This report is going to focus mainly on the preparation of an IV-able solution of alprazolam (aka Xanax). .This should work for other benzodiazepines as well. It's pretty simple.
1. I Crush up pill up into a fine powder
and put it into a spoon.
2. Next, I draw up approximately equal amounts of propylene glycol (can be purchased online) and water. The propylene glycol takes a while to draw up as it is more viscous than water. I Add this to the spoon with my pill powder in it.
3. The rest is pretty much the same as cooking anything else; Boiling the solution and breaking up any small chunks remaining.
4. I then filter as usual. Preferably with a micron filter, but using cotton or a cigarette filter if I have nothing else.
5. Inject rather slowly.
The high is just the same as it normally would be, but kicks in much faster. Not much of a rush really, but I'm definitely up there within 30 seconds.
